regions.summary: Complete stored signed-nibble bearing grid: ROM $001CC7..$001DC7, encoded CPU origin $009CC7 in bank $00. Index = ((y & 15) << 4) | (x & 15), with both coordinates signed -8..7. Each byte is a circular heading (256 units per turn); collision code subtracts it from truck headings, while AI adds $40 before steering. All 255 nonzero vectors agree within one circular heading unit with -atan2(y,x)*128/pi; the zero vector retains its existing $FF byte without a defined geometric bearing. This describes the finite stored values, not an exact generator or rounding rule. The inferred 256-byte extent joins the decoded coordinate/heading type and 225 prior typed cells with the full nonlinear grid and independent sine-source origin $009DC7. There is no encoded allocation count. The established magnitude-reduction producer yields only -7..7 in each component (225 indices, confirmed over all 65,536 byte pairs). Stored coordinate -8 capacity is distinct from that read domain; natural nibble-$8 reads remain unresolved. No nonuse, dead-data or new execution claim follows.
